colorsAre: Approximate desired neutral-daylight/unlit appearance proposals, not final shader tint values or approval.

palette.proposal: Reuse trowelled source; calibrate lightness without extra brown tint. Target is desired unlit appearance, not a multiplier.
Use existing quieter plaster source for dark beige aliases; shared sand variant.
Lighter civic/service lime; avoid near-white output.
Concentrate on dye-work ownership, never whole-map filter.
Keep selective merchant/red household identity; subdued source already appropriate.
Keep civic/gateway masonry. Stone units about 0.2m high at this repeat; mortar belongs to wall, not one-piece trim.
Restrict narrow layered rustic scan to existing low service/store masses; avoid cloning it onto additional landmark fronts.
Reuse court_flagstone_01. Choose one shared 3.2m trial repeat across linked flag areas, not 2.6m/4.4m switches of the same visible units.
Keep medieval_blocks_05 only where robust service/court paving is intended; do not inflate repeat to 3.6m merely for variation.

Keep existing bounded grainMix 0.12 paint recipe. Reuse for shades and sacks; use finer physical repeat for domestic linen only after close sample. Replace leather source on linen; no new texture required for first sample.

Retain R5 warmTimber bounded grainMix 0.28 recipe. Source is faded gray-brown with real board seams; member UVs must select grain within a board. Retain the current numeric paint binding; the appearance chip is illustrative, not a new paint instruction.
Retain the exact R5 owner paint assignment. This supersedes the earlier illustrative darker accent swatch; see accent-assignments-proposal.json.
Retain the exact R5 owner paint assignment. This supersedes the earlier illustrative darker accent swatch; see accent-assignments-proposal.json.
Propose muted rust only for existing Spice shade SHADE_S_W_SHOP_1. Keep the other 15 shades cream and retain all existing authored stock colors. See exact accent assignments.
Retain unmodified existing rug: muted indigo, rust, teal and flax already form the right accent family.

Retain R5 craft override. Raw rusty_metal_02 is light zinc-gray/orange, so do not bind raw albedo on straps. Retain the current numeric paint binding; the appearance chip is illustrative, not a new paint instruction.
